interpretation: The named fourfold centre and its reflected partner carry inverse rotation matrices with the same positive quarter-period offset. Spatial reflection reverses rotational handedness; it does not reverse time.
The equation q(gx,t+tau*T)=q(x,t) means a feature at x is reproduced at gx after tau*T. Equivalently the later image is the pullback q(g^-1*x,t).

Clockwise/counterclockwise on screen additionally depends on the renderer camera orientation. Finite phase symmetry alone specifies an endpoint relation, not a unique continuous angular velocity; local winding/fitting below are supplementary measurements.
